round_goal: Restore the all-green harness state by fixing the unauthenticated `/policy-lab` page flow so Tier 2 stops failing without weakening the existing admin gate.

priorities.title: Fix `/policy-lab` auth handling so the page no longer 500s for anonymous visits
priorities.action: Edit `policy_lab_page` to keep the existing admin check but stop crashing on the `except HTTPException` path. Remove the local `HTTPException` shadowing bug, and make unauthenticated access follow the same browser-safe behavior as `/pledge` by redirecting to `/login?next=/policy-lab...` instead of returning a 500 or thin error response. The route should still serve `policy-lab.html` for authorized users so the page keeps its existing `lang` and `title` metadata.

priorities.title: Add a regression check for the `/policy-lab` page route
priorities.action: Add or update a focused test so this route cannot regress back to a server error. Cover the unauthenticated `/policy-lab` request path and assert it redirects cleanly instead of raising, while preserving the current requirement that the route still calls `require_admin` in its implementation.

generator_prompt: Implement only the `/policy-lab` repair. The current Tier 2 failure is caused by `backend/policy_admin_routes.py` where `policy_lab_page` crashes with `UnboundLocalError` because `HTTPException` is shadowed inside the function, and anonymous visits to `/policy-lab` are not handled like other protected browser pages. Fix that route so it still enforces admin-or-drafter access for real use, but anonymous browser visits redirect to `/login?next=...` instead of producing a 500 or bare JSON error. Keep the scope narrow, preserve the existing `require_admin` call in the route, and add a regression test covering the unauthenticated path.
